clips.title: The story
paras: At Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart seeks hardy trackers to hunt Loch Modan's crocolisks. Their skins and meat bring steady trade, though the hunt along the lake's shores and islands is dangerous.

Loch Modan's mountain waters look calm, but fierce predators lurk beneath the surface. Crocolisks gather in the shallows and along muddy banks, making crossings and fishing dangerous for the unwary. At Farstrider Lodge, these reptiles are valuable game. Craftsmen and tailors across Khaz Modan seek their durable hides for rugged armor and leather goods. Rustic taverns pay well for fresh cuts of their lean, flavorful tail meat.

Crocolisk hunting in Loch Modan calls for more than novice trapping. The beasts gather mainly around the lake's rocky islets, where bone-crushing jaws and razor-sharp teeth make them dangerous opponents. Dwarven veterans such as Marek Ironheart bear scars from wrestling them into submission. He warns newcomers that one misstep in the water can cost a limb. Skinning and butchering a crocolisk takes patience, sturdy steel, and a willingness to enter its hunting ground.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, friend. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
